Andy Brown

Democratic candidate for Travis County Judge, Travis County, Texas · Incumbent

Travis County Judge; attorney

Listed as unopposed for this office. Grew up in Austin and helped establish Sobering Center Austin.

Where Brown stands

Homelessness and housing
Directed $110 million in federal Rescue Act funds to homelessness and backs expanded stable housing.
Public safety
Favors crime prevention, behavioral health services and diversion over building new jails.
Transportation
Is advancing a passenger rail link between Austin and San Antonio.
Child care
Supports county child care scholarships.

Background

  • Travis County Judge, 2020–present
  • Colorado College; University of Texas School of Law
